note: Where each number in data/ comes from (CLAUDE.md, 'Fetched data is documented and held to its source'; tools/check_sources.py, the ctest entry data_sources). Every numeric value under data/ (a JSON number or decimal string; a CSV table as a whole) must match an entry's pattern. A pattern is a path: the file, then keys; an array of objects is keyed by each one's id, symbol or name, any other array by '#'. '{a,b}' is any of its names; '*' and '**' only as the last segment (one key; anything below), so a new file, species, reaction, item or medium matches nothing until it is entered here. An entry is measured (tests: the TEST_CASEs that hold it to its source; doc: phrases docs/DATA_SOURCES.md must contain), calibrated (why; doc; tests optional) or design (why: a choice of the game, not a claim about the world).
